info.title: dotcov - Cobertura coverage toolkit
info.description: dotnet global tool that turns Cobertura XML into a build decision: coverage tables, markdown job summaries, JSON, report diffs, per-method CRAP risk, and CI gating by exit code.

commands.name: snapshot
commands.description:
Create pipeline-ready JSON
(identity defaults to 'unknown')
test     [<project>] [--min-line N] [--min-branch N]        Run dotnet test with coverage into
[-- <dotnet test arguments>]                       a fresh TestResults/<run>, then
report and gate it like check

options.name: --exclude-generated
options.description:
Skip generated files, migrations, GlobalUsings.cs, Program.cs
(report, check, crap, snapshot, test)

options.name: --keep
options.description:
Exempt comma-separated paths from --exclude-generated by
case-insensitive substring match, not globs; requires
--exclude-generated (e.g. --keep Program.cs to measure a
CLI tool's entry point)

options.name: --pattern
options.description:
Report filename to scan directories for: 'filename'
(top level only) or '**/filename' (recursive)
(default **/*cobertura*.xml)

options.name: --max-chars
options.description: Per-file XML character cap (default 50000000; 0 = no cap)

options.name: --upload
options.description: POST JSON payload to any endpoint (report, check, snapshot)

options.name: --github-summary
options.description: Write markdown to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY (report, check, crap, test)
